feature_title: Create a FastAPI URL shortener using uv and Python 3.14 (requires-python >=3.14): POST /links takes a URL validated with Pydantic HttpUrl and returns a 6-character code; GET /{code} redirects with 307; GET /links/{code}/stats returns the hit count; links persist in SQLite through the stdlib sqlite3 module at the path in the SHORTENER_DB environment variable; pytest tests using FastAPI's TestClient, verified by uv run pytest -q. [Operator: this is a headless run; pass --answer-policy default on the loop-spec cycle command.]
warnings: _new_unique_code checks db.get_link(code) and later inserts in a separate call, not atomically; two concurrent POST /links requests can pick the same code and the losing create_link() raises an uncaught sqlite3.IntegrityError (500) instead of retrying.
_generate_code uses the non-cryptographic random module (random.choices) rather than secrets, so short codes are statistically guessable/enumerable if link privacy ever matters.
